sections.text: TAF15 encodes an RNA-binding transcriptional regulator in the FET protein family.

sections.text: TAF15::NR4A3 is a recurrent fusion in extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma, confirmed by fusion-transcript and rearrangement assays in primary tumor cohorts.

report_comment.text: TAF15 encodes an RNA-binding transcriptional regulator in the FET protein family. NR4A3 encodes an orphan nuclear-receptor transcription factor. TAF15::NR4A3 is a recurrent fusion in extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma, confirmed by fusion-transcript and rearrangement assays in primary tumor cohorts.
